versions.changelog: Fixed: renamed bin/valtec-tts to bin/valtec-tts.js so ClawHub includes it in install, added Vietnamese description
Added Vietnamese description, removed bundled Python scripts
Security fix: removed bundled Python script, simplified wrapper to match approved skill patterns

- Initial release of valtec-tts: Vietnamese text-to-speech with zero-shot voice cloning.
- Synthesizes high-quality Vietnamese speech from text using a local PyTorch model.
- Supports 5 built-in voices (3 female, 2 male) with a multi-speaker mode.
- Enables zero-shot voice cloning from short reference audio clips (3–10 seconds).
- Fully offline operation; no cloud API required.
- Supports both GPU (CUDA) and CPU inference.
